page.notes: Printing errors left as printed: "fortein" (for "forte in"), "1." in "obstat 1. Quod" is a small numeral that may be an objection number, read as 1 with some doubt. Long s was read as plain s throughout, so "conscifcat" became "consciscat" and "Refp.enim." became "Resp.enim.". The last word "betur," is the completion of "ha-" from the line above and belongs to the text.
